summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo without committing, running tests, or installing packages. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges and yields one Text with range_clicked click spans; Opacity now blends color into the existing style so metadata is kept; the layout resolver Edge protocol is documented (min_size already existed, arithmetic unchanged); docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; a new required underline test appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py; and tests/test_tabs.py. Existing tests were not modified. Nothing was executed, so all verification is by reading. Choices to review: bar position indexes the full tab list (needed for find_tab_by_name with duplicates), click action quotes the tab name via repr, zero-width labels are skipped as layout edges, and action_range_clicked is synchronous.
